en: Archie
What... what has happened? What is this wretched sight?
Did I... Have I made some terrible mistake?
I only... I only wanted...
Maxie
Do you see it now, Archie? Do you see what your dream has turned into?
We have no time. Something must be done before this is past anyone's power to stop!
{player}, say nothing. I know I have no right to judge Archie.
And I doubt that people like us can do anything against power like this.
But we can't stand here and watch. Putting an end to it is our task, Archie's and mine.
Those ancient Pokémon... Their power is beyond anything we imagined. They have thrown all of nature off its balance...
Steven
{player}! What is going on here?
This is terrible... First a heat wave, and now this downpour.
If it doesn't stop, it will drown all of Hoenn. No, the whole world.
These storm clouds are spreading from over Sootopolis City. What on earth is happening there?
There's no sense standing here wondering. Sootopolis may have the answer.
{player}... I don't know what you mean to do, but don't do anything reckless.
Right. I'm going to Sootopolis.
Isaiah
You swim like you battle: fast and hard. Let's keep pushing each other!
Register Isaiah in the PokéNav's Match Call?
Great! I'll call you from the reef.
Fair enough. Another hundred laps for me, then.
Katelyn
You beat me fair and square. I want a rematch once I've trained some more!
Register Katelyn in the PokéNav's Match Call?
I'll call you the moment I'm faster!
Then I'll just have to find you out here again.
